exposure: Isolated absent septum pellucidum diagnosed by fetal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
outcome: Postnatal diagnosis of absent septum pellucidum
Additional related findings on postnatal MRI
cohort: The study included 8 fetuses diagnosed by fetal MRI with isolated absent septum pellucidum without other intracranial abnormalities.
finding: The majority of fetuses (6 out of 8) with isolated absent septum pellucidum retained this diagnosis postnatally without septo-optic dysplasia or significant related findings on postnatal MRI, and had normal endocrine and ophthalmologic evaluations; one subject without septo-optic dysplasia experienced developmental delays.
